essence: Because she both subdues enemies and grants prosperity, the goddess is a fitting object of worship.
Her purity and distinctive yellow attire make her a worthy refuge for the speaker.
Her affinity for pure conduct and devotees makes Bhavānī the object of the speaker's worship.
Being worshipped even by the lotus-born confirms her supreme status and worthiness of reverence.
The goddess is characterized as transcending or being beyond the limiting qualities of nature.
